# Design decisions

`S4.2` · Coding rule

Gray neutrals; DIN only everywhere (incl. manager portal); danger #E94A5D (+ #B91C1C for red text); disabled = 40% opacity; Find Leads / Map View style actions are outline action chips; web uses the same token names with smaller sizes.

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-shared|Rules for all code]].
